title: Lever 8: Li+-coordination feature block, motivated by ACS Energy Lett. 2025, 10, 4962 (10.1021/acsenergylett.5c02291)
lock_rule: Criteria and kill lines frozen before the run. Never relaxed afterwards.
why: The project's own ceiling analysis (appendix X, X-2) says the R2 is capped because a structure-only descriptor set cannot see the collective polarisation term: the Kirkwood g dimension, the association strength. Our blind-spot measurement has the same shape (associating liquids MAE 11.5 against 5.0 in domain). The review catalogues the solvating-power descriptors that proxy exactly that missing dimension and explicitly sorts them by whether they are computable from structure alone.

source_paper.title: Elucidating the Solvating Power of Solvents for Designing High-Performance Electrolytes in Lithium Batteries
source_paper.what_it_is: a taxonomy of quantitative solvating-power descriptors in three families: intrinsic solvent properties (dipole moment, dielectric constant, ESP), probe-solvent interaction strength (basicity, Gibbs free energy, binding energy, Li bond), and bulk electrolyte properties (diffusion coefficient, chemical shift, AGG percentage)
source_paper.what_it_is_not: it does not predict the static dielectric constant of a pure solvent. It is a feature catalogue, not a model, and not a data table for our target.

the_one_sentence_verdict: The review is usable as a feature-menu, not as a model. Of its descriptors exactly two families are both cheap for us to compute and target-aligned: the electrostatic-potential descriptors (family 1) and the Li+ binding energy (family 2). Everything else is either experimental (donor number, beta, NMR and Raman shifts, AGG percent) or needs an electrolyte, and so can only enter as a small hand-curated look-up table.

features: li_binding_energy_ev (E(Li+ . solvent) - E(solvent) - E(Li+), same pinned xTB protocol and the same single-thread launcher)
li_binding_distance_a (shortest Li-O/N distance in the relaxed complex)
q_max_h (largest positive Mulliken charge on a hydrogen, the donor-acidity axis)
q_min_hetero (most negative Mulliken charge on O or N, the basicity axis)
esp_imbalance (q_max_h minus q_min_hetero, a one-number coordination asymmetry)
block_definition.why_these_and_not_donor_number: donor number and beta are measured against a probe molecule, not computed; our roster has no such column and building one would be a hand-curated table of unknown coverage. Partial charges and the Li+ binding energy are computed by the same xTB binary we already pin, so the block is reproducible end to end and carries no licence-encumbered data.
block_definition.cost: one extra xTB relaxation per compound for the Li+ complex. Bounded: if the measured per-compound cost puts the full table out of reach, run a bounded pilot and register the remainder as pending rather than extrapolating.

scoreboard.model: XGBRegressor with the frozen v1.0 hyper-parameters

arms: baseline (frozen v03 physical + Morgan, re-run in this script)
plus_coordination_block (the five new columns appended, no existing column touched)
placebo (the same block, target shuffled, must collapse)
pass_criterion: grouped R2 on the main scoreboard increases by at least +0.0200 against the baseline arm re-run in the same script
secondary_criterion: the mae_gt60 stratum must not get worse, and the placebo arm must collapse (|delta R2| <= 0.0200)
kill_line: delta R2 below +0.0050, or a placebo arm that does not collapse, or a lift that exists only in the MAE strata while total R2 falls -> dead, reported as dead
secondary_deliverable: a descriptor-catalogue extraction: every descriptor named in the review mapped against the 13 columns of the frozen v03 physical block, marked computable-now / computable-with-extra-xTB / experimental-only, plus the structural design strategies the review names (methylation and fluorination of DME, DOL, DMC, EMC) as new-compound candidates for AL Round 4. This half is a literature-to-repo mapping, not a model change.
forbidden: row-level random splits for any conclusion
letting test residuals steer which descriptors enter the block
changing the score mask, the compound set or the fold numbers
quoting a donor number or a chemical shift as if it were computed here
quoting 0.5332 or 0.5454 next to the v1.0 headline 0.364 without their pool definitions

shots_policy.rule: attempts at the main scoreboard are counted in reports/decisions_log.md section 12
